checked_profile.summary: Personal loans with flexible terms and restrictions on direct creditor payments.
checked_profile.scope: Selected product features and conditions from the provider sources below. This is not a personalized offer, approval decision, or complete fee or policy schedule.

facts.label: Amounts and terms
facts.text: Discover advertises $2,500–$40,000 with repayment terms of 36, 48, 60, 72 or 84 months.

facts.label: Published APR
facts.text: The provider comparison table displays 6.99%–24.99% APR and says its comparison information runs through July 8, 2026. A personalized offer determines the rate available to you; verify current pricing before applying.

facts.label: Fees
facts.text: The advertised new-loan offer states no fees for any customer. Existing loan agreements may have different terms.

facts.label: Debt payments
facts.text: Direct creditor payment excludes Capital One accounts, including Discover cards, secured loans and post-secondary education loans or expenses.
